import sys,random,time
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission');sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
from compiler import compile_plan
from test_compiler import check

def test(seed,n=32,k=32,ntrees=8):
 random.seed(seed)
 edges=[(u,u+1) for u in range(n-1)]+[(0,n-1)]
 rem=[(u,v) for u in range(n) for v in range(u+1,n) if (u,v) not in edges]
 edges+=random.sample(rem,128-len(edges))
 C=random.sample(range(n),k)
 parts=[[v,random.randint(0,10**11)] for v in C]
 adj=[[] for _ in range(n)]
 for i,(u,v) in enumerate(edges): adj[u].append((v,i,0)); adj[v].append((u,i,1))
 loads=[[0,0] for e in edges]
 for v,r in parts:
  for _ in range(ntrees):
   visited={v}; q=[v]
   for u in q:
    random.shuffle(adj[u])
    for w,i,d in adj[u]:
     if w not in visited:
      visited.add(w); q.append(w); loads[i][d]+=r//ntrees+1
 env=[[i,max(loads[i])] for i in range(len(edges)) if max(loads[i])]
 s=time.monotonic();plan,cut=compile_plan(n,edges,parts,env,1)
 check(n,edges,parts,env,1,plan,cut)
 t=time.monotonic()-s
 print(seed,n,k,ntrees,round(t,2), [len(plan[q]) for q in ('trees','routes','recipes')], flush=True)
 return t
if __name__=='__main__':
 for seed in range(12): test(seed)
